About.name: Marina Kholodova
About.bio: I'm Marina, a frontend developer. I'm inspired by mountains and snowboarding — it's my way to recharge. I got into development out of curiosity about web technologies, which grew into a passion for creating modern and user-friendly interfaces. I enjoy building interfaces that are intuitive and pleasant to use. In the future, I want to grow as a frontend specialist and contribute to creating meaningful and useful products.
